scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: node --import tsx --import ./test/setup.ts --import ./test/teardown.ts --test --test-concurrency=1 test/scoring.test.ts test/secrets.test.ts test/http.test.ts test/dispatch.test.ts test/operationalAlerts.test.ts
scripts.test:coverage: node --import tsx --import ./test/setup.ts --import ./test/teardown.ts --experimental-test-coverage --test --test-concurrency=1 test/scoring.test.ts test/secrets.test.ts test/http.test.ts test/dispatch.test.ts test/operationalAlerts.test.ts test/integration.test.ts test/dispatchOperations.integration.test.ts test/operationalAlerts.integration.test.ts
